def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[0],pts[1]
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    g[(r1+r2)//2][(c1+c2)//2]=1
    return g
